title: Semaglutide in Alcohol Use Disorder
official: A 45-week, Randomized, Controlled Trial of Semaglutide on Alcohol Related Outcomes in Adults With Alcohol Use Disorder and Obesity
summary: This is a 45-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial designed to compare the effectiveness of semaglutide versus placebo on alcohol-related outcomes among 128 adults with alcohol use disorder (AUD) and obesity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-65 years
* Meet Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5) criteria for AUD
* \>/=1 bout of heavy drinking (defined as \>/= 4 drinks/day for females; \>/= 5 drinks/day for males) within the last month
* Have an interest in reducing or quitting alcohol intake
* Have obesity (defined as BMI \>/= 30 kg/m2) at screening
* Ability to provide informed consent before any trial-related activities

Exclusion Criteria:

* Impaired ability to provide consent to a clinical trial and/or comply with study procedures and/or measures using a smartphone (e.g., intellectual disability, acute intoxication, etc.)
* Meet Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5) criteria for Severe AUD
* Lifetime diagnosis of psychosis and/or bipolar-spectrum disorders
* Serious withdrawal symptoms defined as a score higher than 9 on Clinical Institute Withdrawal Assessment (CIWA) for Alcohol Scale, Revised at the baseline visit
* Current or history of neurological disease including traumatic brain injury
* Diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus
* Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus with A1c \>/= 10% or type 2 diabetes mellitus on insulin therapy
* Current hyperthyroidism or uncontrolled hypothyroidism
* Current pregnancy or breast-feeding, plans to become pregnant within the next 12 months, or if sexually active refusal to use adequate contraceptive measures
* Impaired hepatic function (aspartate aminotransferase (AST)or alanine aminotransferase (ALT) \> 3 times upper normal limit
* Impaired renal function (estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR)\< 50 mL/minute
* Known hypersensitivity to semaglutide
* Any history of pancreatitis (acute or chronic; contraindication for semaglutide)
* Triglycerides \>/= 1000 mg/dL
* History of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) and/or family history with MTC and/or multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome type 2 (contraindication for semaglutide)
* Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure \> 180 mm Hg; diastolic blood pressure \> 110 mm Hg)
* Concomitant pharmacotherapy for alcohol dependence (e.g. disulfiram, naltrexone, acamprosate) or treatment with any of these within 35 days prior to screening visit
* Current or recent (\< 6 months prior to screening) use of weight loss medication(s) (e.g., phentermine, Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist (GLP1-RAs)) or other weight altering medication(s) (e.g., atypical anti-psychotics), unless dose(s) of these have been stable for \>6 months from screening
* Any condition that the investigator feels would interfere with trial participation
